title.zh: 标普全球评级发布链上借贷Vault风险评估体系
title.en: 标普全球评级发布链上借贷Vault风险评估体系

current_state.zh: S&P Global Ratings introduced its Vault Risk Assessment (VRA) framework, a new rating system using symbols such as AAA(v) to evaluate on-chain lending vaults that provide liquidity against crypto assets and tokenized RWA collateral, assessing underlying asset credit risk, protocol and blockchain risk, vault manager risk, and liquidity.
current_state.en: S&P Global Ratings introduced its Vault Risk Assessment (VRA) framework, a new rating system using symbols such as AAA(v) to evaluate on-chain lending vaults that provide liquidity against crypto assets and tokenized RWA collateral, assessing underlying asset credit risk, protocol and blockchain risk, vault manager risk, and liquidity.
